entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I need to make a return, I think. I have this helmet, and I'm just so confused by the whole process on your website.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, could you tell me a bit more? Is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a preference issue?

Oh, um, a preference? I guess? It’s not broken. The online pictures made the color look different. It's still in the original packaging, the box is unopened and everything. I just... I don't understand the policy. Can't you just help me?
Of course. Let me just pull up your account information. I see the order here for the Aero Road Helmet. It looks like it was delivered about 34 days ago. Let me just check our current policy for you.
Okay... I was worried it was too late. It's all a bit overwhelming.

Not at all. I've just checked our knowledge base, and you are well within the 90-day return window. I can absolutely start that return for you right now. We want to make sure you're completely satisfied with the fit and safety features of your gear.
Oh! Really? Ninety days? That's wonderful! I was so stressed about it. Thank you so much.

You're very welcome. I am generating a prepaid return label and sending it to the email address we have on file. Simply print it, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the helmet, we'll process your full refund.
That's perfect. You've been a huge help, Sarah.
I'm happy I could assist. Is there anything else for you today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again!
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
